asset.name: Invoice rejected
asset.description: Sent to the vendor when AP rejects the invoice.
asset.subject: Invoice {{invoice_number}} rejected
asset.html_body:
We could not accept your invoice

Hello {{vendor_name}},

Invoice {{invoice_number}} ({{currency}} {{=FORMAT_NUMBER(invoice_total, 2)}}) against PO {{po_number}} was rejected.

Reason: {{task_data.reason}}. {{task_data.resolution_note}}

Please send a corrected invoice quoting the PO number.

Sent by the accounts payable team at your company
